resources.string: Choose who can call you, or turn off calling on this device.
These permissions apply only to this device. They are separate from muting chats and notification settings. Changing a call permission ends any current call on this device.
Disable all calling on this device
Stops incoming and outgoing calls, group calls and call links. Contact and group exceptions cannot override this.
All calling is disabled on this device. Turn off the device restriction in Settings → Collie → Calls to change incoming-call permissions.
Applies to individual contacts unless you choose a different permission in their conversation settings. You can still choose to call a contact whose incoming calls are blocked.

Applies to incoming group calls unless you choose a different permission in that group’s conversation settings. You can still choose to join a group call. Allowing a group does not allow its members to call you privately.

Choose whether this contact may call you. Existing blocks and identity checks still apply. Blocking incoming calls does not stop you from calling them. Changing this permission ends any current call on this device.

This permission applies only to incoming calls in this group. You can still choose to join a group call. It does not change whether members can call you privately, or allow calls in other groups. Changing this permission ends any current call on this device.
Call permissions are unavailable. Calling stays blocked until they can be read.
The change could not be saved. Review the current setting and try again.
